items.headline: New self-storage facility permitted on Gimelli Way
items.summary: A $14.6 million permit was issued for new construction of the SJ Self Storage warehouse/storage facility at 2444 Gimelli Way

items.headline: Phase I construction permitted for school/daycare on Rincon Ave
items.summary: A $28.6 million Phase I new construction permit was issued for a School/Daycare project at 4333 Rincon Avenue, one of the largest permits in this batch.

items.headline: Palo Alto may allow housing in ROLM(E) research zone
items.summary: The Economic Development Committee is set to recommend a zoning ordinance change clarifying that multiple-family residential uses could be conditionally permitted in the ROLM(E) office/research/manufacturing zone. The recommendation would go to the City Council for final action.

items.headline: Council to hear appeal of Civic Center Drive townhome project
items.summary: The council is scheduled to consider an appeal of a permit approval for a project at 860 and 858 Civic Center Drive and 1526 Alviso Street that would demolish existing buildings and build 14 townhomes plus a duplex with commercial space.

items.headline: Scoping meeting held for Oakmead Parkway housing project's environmental review
items.summary: A public scoping meeting was held for the environmental impact report on a proposed residential project at 1250 Oakmead Parkway, giving residents a chance to weigh in on what the environmental study should cover.

items.headline: Council to respond to grand jury report on pothole claims
items.summary: The City Council is set to approve a response to a Santa Clara County Civil Grand Jury report on improving how pothole damage claims are processed.

items.headline: Stanford to keep paying for stadium traffic control
items.summary: The Council is set to approve a five-year agreement with Stanford University for the city to provide traffic control services during Stanford Stadium events.
